capabilities.foundly_current: Owned stages and opportunities, permission-filtered period forecasts with separate currencies and explicit unknown values, revision-bound immutable snapshots with restart and replay protection. Managed owner quotas now bind exact periods and currency to persisted forecasts. Explicit source-revision-bound probability scenarios and immutable scenario snapshots now pass exact rounding, currency/null semantics, owner isolation, read-only HTTP queries and encrypted restart. Sales scenarios now accept separately typed probability, amount in integer minor units, and valid close-date assumptions against exact current opportunity revisions. Existing source opportunities are never changed. Explicit dates move authorized open opportunities into or out of the selected period, including initially outside-period sources; missing amount/currency/probability remains literal and never becomes a complete projection implicitly. Currency totals, exact explicit-probability rounding, missing-data uncertainty, zero amounts, period boundaries, invalid input, source ownership/capabilities, stale revisions and immutable snapshot replay/rollback/restart are tested. Snapshot access also checks additional scenario-only source records; unused selection candidates are not retained in snapshots. Actual production controls support typed assumptions, current candidate scope with owner/pipeline filters, separate snapshot confirmation, stable lost-response retry and changed/detached response refusal. Actual authenticated HTTP fixtures preserve encrypted snapshots and untouched source records. No live provider, actual browser, accounting revenue or measured competitive superiority is inferred. Phase 24 continues with forecast hierarchy and remaining recorded Sales execution and other module gaps. Sales forecast hierarchy now uses explicitly assigned, immutable hierarchy versions with one root, bounded depth, no cycles and no duplicate owner assignment. Current owner-subtree queries reuse the native forecast and currency/target contracts without granting source access or claiming an organization-wide total. Shared hierarchy readers see only their currently authorized opportunities. Root/child selection, version authoring and separate node-bound native snapshot confirmation have actual UI/native service and real-member HTTP evidence, including lost-response replay, stale/detached result rejection, encrypted restart, generic-write denial and role revocation during request-body waits. Exact node/definition/current source binding protects snapshots; malformed optional scenario/hierarchy values and corrupted stored definitions fail closed. Backend hierarchy-scoped scenarios are supported; the hierarchy UI currently exposes forecast/query and snapshot workflows. CI 117 passed the preceding amount/date scenario checkpoint. Phase 24 remains active. The next Sales pipeline-board gap includes an isolated reproduced defect: a title-only edit reset a recorded probability from 0.9 to the pipeline stage default 0.2; that code defect is recorded for immediate correction, not waived. Remaining sequence/communication and other module gaps, actual browser/live-provider/production and measured competitive gates remain open. The isolated Sales defect where a title-only update reset explicit probability from 0.9 to stage default 0.2 is fixed. Non-transition edits preserve recorded probability; actual stage/pipeline changes apply defaults unless an explicit probability is supplied. The native Sales board now supports typed pipeline/stage editing, explicit read-only sharing, current owner-scoped currency totals and paged records, keyboard and drag preparation followed by separate revision-bound confirmation, and exact durable operation receipts. Used stages cannot be removed, shared readers cannot modify pipeline definitions, lost responses do not duplicate writes, current source/role/sharing/capability and pipeline revisions are rechecked, and real native Sales events record the actual stage transition without claiming a CRM event or changing recorded closed status. Internal receipts remain outside business exports/Data. Unit, production UI/native handlers and real-member HTTP tests cover these behaviors, atomic rollback, encrypted restart and permission revocation during body waits. Hierarchy-scoped amount/date/probability scenario controls now use the exact selected owner subtree and native node-bound snapshot path. CI 118 passed the previous hierarchy checkpoint. Phase 24 remains active: sequence execution and communication handoff, full Sales prepare/execute/verify and outcome feedback, and the remaining recorded module gaps are next. No actual browser, live-provider, production or competitive superiority is inferred.
